core.title: Classic Oval Glass Wall Mounted Soap Dish, Deltana 98C2012

text.description_html:
Deltana 98C2012, Traditional Wall Mounted Soap Holder With Oval Glass Dish

The traditional appeal of the 98C Series Soap Holder can be found both in the classic steeped wall mount and in the 3 beautiful finishes in which it is available. The bracket and rose are made of solid brass (available in satin nickel, polished chrome, or oil rubbed bronze finishes) and the dish is made of white frosted glass. It is made with the attention to quality Deltana is known for and when mounted to the wall, this soap dish will make a ultra fashionable--yet functional--accessory to any bathroom.

Shop more of the Deltana 98C Series Bathroom Accessories

Features and Specifications of the 98C Solid Brass Classic Soap Dish:

  • Soap Dish Diameter: 4-3/8"
  • Overall Projection: 5-5/8"
  • Wall Mount Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Material: solid brass wall mount (available in satin nickel, polished chrome, or oil rubbed bronze finishes) with a white frosted glass dish
  • Deltana 98C2012 Soap Holder with Glass Specifications (PDF)

Sold Individually. Package includes: 1 soap dish, mounting screw cover, and all necessary mounting screws.
